correctness.rationale: Explicit disjoint-block operator has row sums lambda_n<1 tending to one, so operator and adjoint fail norm attainment and bidual attains. Independent binomial blocks give almost-sure relative-entropy limsup by Chernoff/type bounds and Borel–Cantelli; strict finite-row gaps give the exact sign norming phase. Cylinder extension and a sparse forced-block mass-distribution argument give dense G_delta, dense complement, and full Hausdorff dimension. The 2,370 finite diagnostics check auxiliary identities only.

value.rationale: For the 2026 universal c0 bidual norm-attainment phenomenon, exact prevalence of norming extreme points is a natural finer invariant. The construction separates three notions—existence/category, Hausdorff dimension, and Bernoulli almost-sure norming—with a sharp bias-sensitive logarithmic boundary. Its exact quotient-output norm describes the complete supercritical regime and is not merely a one-bit threshold. This is a narrowly scoped structural classification, not a generic numerical example.
